data.professional_title: Business Transformation Consultant | Process Excellence | Lean Six Sigma Black Belt | Operational Excellence
data.summary:
Business Transformation and Process Excellence professional with 9+ years of experience delivering enterprise transformation, Lean Six Sigma, operational excellence, consulting and AI-enabled business transformation initiatives across manufacturing, consulting and digital environments.
Lean Six Sigma Black Belt and Prosci Certified Change Practitioner with hands-on experience across DMAIC, process discovery, VSM, process re-engineering, statistical problem solving, capability building, stakeholder influencing and transformation governance.
Experienced in mobilising BB/GB/YB Lean Six Sigma programmes, supporting formal assessments/examinations and certification, creating LSS learning resources, driving Process Engineering community engagement, establishing communication/newsletter standards and facilitating idea-generation and innovation initiatives.
Proven track record of coaching improvement projects, training 100+ professionals, leading ~30 Six Sigma projects and delivering measurable efficiency, productivity and cost benefits.
POSITIONING FOR PROCESS ENGINEERING MANAGER
Targeting senior Process Excellence / Process Engineering leadership roles requiring Lean Six Sigma capability building, global transformation, consulting, stakeholder influencing, community development, innovation, Process/Data Discovery and AI-enabled continuous improvement.

experience.role: Business Transformation Consultant – AI & SaaS Product Transformation
responsibilities: Lead AI-enabled SaaS product and business transformation initiatives using Agile, Design Thinking, Lean Six Sigma, BPM and Prosci Change Management.
Manage 3–4 concurrent cross-functional projects, driving sprint execution, governance, stakeholder alignment and 85%+ on-time delivery.
Lead end-to-end product operations including backlog prioritisation, requirements management, UAT, release readiness and go-to-market coordination.
Facilitate requirements elicitation and develop BRDs, BPDs, user stories, functional specifications and process governance documentation.
Design current-state/future-state process maps, customer journeys, service blueprints and operating models to drive process optimisation and automation.
Develop governance dashboards and KPI reporting frameworks covering scope, budget, risks, dependencies and delivery performance.
Lead Process Excellence and continuous-improvement initiatives, delivering 15–20% cycle-time reduction and 10–15% fewer escalations.
Partner with global stakeholders across US and Australian engagements to support transformation, change adoption, governance and continuous improvement.
Mobilise LSS capability-building activities, community engagement, knowledge sharing and communication initiatives aligned to transformation objectives.

experience.role: Assistant Manager – Business Transformation & Operational Excellence
responsibilities: Led enterprise-wide Business Transformation initiatives across three manufacturing sites, partnering with business leaders to identify opportunities and implement sustainable solutions.
Managed a team of 12+ cross-functional professionals delivering 25+ Lean Six Sigma and process-improvement projects.
Facilitated stakeholder workshops, Process Discovery sessions and VSM exercises to analyse current-state operations and define future-state solutions.
Delivered 20% throughput improvement, 5% cost reduction and significant energy optimisation through Lean Six Sigma and operational excellence initiatives.
Established project governance frameworks, executive dashboards, KPI reporting and performance-review mechanisms for senior leadership.
Conducted RCA using Lean, Six Sigma, A3, 5 Why and statistical techniques.
Trained and mentored 100+ professionals in problem-solving methodologies and continuous-improvement practices.
Supported LSS BB/GB/YB capability-building programmes through practitioner engagement, training, assessment/certification activities and project coaching.
Created LSS project materials, templates, case studies and knowledge resources; supported Process Excellence communications, newsletters and reporting standards.
Organised Process Excellence community sessions/events and facilitated knowledge-sharing forums to increase adoption of Lean practices.
Facilitated idea-generation and innovation initiatives, including evaluation, implementation and replication of improvement ideas.
Partnered with client leadership teams to analyse business operations, identify performance gaps and design process-improvement strategies.
Conducted stakeholder interviews, operational diagnostics, Process Discovery and process assessments across manufacturing and chemical-industry clients.
Delivered operational excellence projects resulting in 36% efficiency improvement and 20 MT production-capacity enhancement.
Facilitated Kaizen workshops and improvement initiatives for senior management teams.
Improved quality-control productivity by 30% through time-motion studies, workflow optimisation and process redesign.
Developed process maps, improvement roadmaps, implementation plans and executive presentations to support transformation initiatives.
Supported change adoption, stakeholder alignment, LSS coaching and communication throughout project implementation.

experience.role: Supply Chain Analyst – Supply Chain Management
responsibilities: Designed and implemented warehouse operations supporting BSVI compliance requirements.
Led supplier evaluation and procurement coordination activities.
Developed KPI tracking and reporting frameworks to improve operational visibility.
Delivered approximately 10% improvement in warehouse efficiency through process redesign and optimisation.
Developed and implemented SOPs, work instructions and quality-assurance processes.
Performed RCA, FMEA, corrective actions and process audits.
Conducted employee training programmes and supported continuous-improvement initiatives.
